The system has broken repeatedly because routes were missing, unregistered on the Express server, or had no auth guard. This document defines every route in one place so Cursor registers all of them in the correct order with the correct auth class.

⚖ LAW: No frontend action may modify core system state directly. Every mutation goes through API validation, event creation, and engine processing. Routes validate access and intent — engines decide system behavior.
⚖ LAW: The /api/onboarding/select-blueprint POST route MUST be registered on the Express server. It was missing in production and caused 404 on every blueprint launch attempt.
